text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, phew... fuu...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I haven't been able to change a single thing yet.
My weapon... still isn't anywhere to be found..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...! What should I do...
I...――Mother...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
!
That's...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're practically empty-handed today!
Even though you were carrying an armful on the first day.
choice_data_list: There were so many that we had a rough time...
There were so many that we had a rough time...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right!
We should keep our luggage as light as possible, or just traveling will drain all our energy.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Mountains are terrifying places!

Honing the "heart"
that serves as Daring Heart's greatest weapon—
Several weeks had already passed since we began our mountain seclusion, the method she had suggested.
With special permission from both the academy and the mountain's owner, we head to the mountain alongside the summer training camp. Basically, we returned to the forest at night to camp out.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let's give it our all
today as well!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Hurry up!
Come on, dash right up!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Mountain trails are even tougher if you climb them slowly!
Keep up the tempo—one, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay!
We've reached the campsite!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a really steep incline.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, good work! But you've also
become able to go quite long distances now.
choice_data_list: Maybe they've finally gotten used to it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then,
are you starting to appreciate this lifestyle?
For meals, we basically live off mountain greens and river fish we catch ourselves—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Climbing and running through untamed, rough nature...
relentlessly confronting my own limits.
choice_data_list: You're really in survival mode, huh...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I want to experience survival!
Listening closely for signs of life, feeling myself immersed in nature...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When you live on the razor's edge—
your spirit is naturally refined.
choice_data_list: I've told you time and again—I won't let you push yourself too hard.
I've told you time and again—I won't let you push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I know. Even so...
You'll watch over me as much as possible, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So that I can push myself to the absolute limit.
So that I can hone my spirit right down to the wire.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "...The upcoming Shuka Sho will undoubtedly push us to our absolute limits."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
At that point, my body's already given everything it's got.
So the only weapon left is—the heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That is why you expose yourself to stress
and continue to place pressure on yourself...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And so, my weapon—my heart—will be complete.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry to keep asking, but
you really didn't have to come along with me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My survival course...
Pretty tough, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Saying I'm "fine"... would be putting on a front, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Still...?
choice_data_list: As an adult and as your Trainer, I'll protect you.
As an adult and as your Trainer, I will protect you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You talk a big game, but I wonder
who it was that just pulled you up
from the cliff?
choice_data_list: Thanks for your help back then...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! You're welcome!
When it comes to protecting, you can count on me too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Alright! Enough chatting for now... Let's do a little bit of training before the real thing. What sounds good?
choice_data_list: Patiently wait for a fish to get caught in the trap

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay!
Which rock are we going for?"

She pointed to a rock that looked just big enough
for one person to sit on. It would be tough even for
a trained human, but for an Umamusume, it should be a good load.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sounds good.
Well then...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
How about that rock for you?
It's shaped like a heart, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fuh... ngh. Haa... ngh!
As expected... this really is just the right load...!
How about you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh... it's not lifting off the ground...
...And here I thought it was the perfect size.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I thought so... It looks like
it'd be best if I protect you, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Okay.
I am satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, it's almost lunchtime...
Let's have salt-grilled fish today!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "It'll run away if you move even a little, so please watch from a distance."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
…………Got you!
You took the bait!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look, look!
We got so many!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazing!
Fufu, maybe I'll go ahead and win enough for dinner too!
"Applauding a proud-looking Daring Heart, I somehow found myself imagining what she was like as a child."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Okay.
I am satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Well then—I'm off.

Beyond this point, she'll venture alone...
deeper into the rugged mountains.
—All to sharpen her mind even further.
choice_data_list: If that alert goes off, you rest right away, you hear me?
If that alert goes off, you need to rest right away, okay?

text_block_list.text:
I had given Daring Heart a smartwatch device.
With this, I could always monitor her vitals
and send alerts if needed.
"We have permission to go further in, and measures are in place to rush over immediately if anything happens... but even so—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I told you not to make that face.
I was the one who practically begged you, remember?
...To leave me alone, that is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Because if you're there... I'll feel at ease.
And if that happens—I won't be able to sharpen my mind."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I'll come back stronger, so wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san...
You went into mountain seclusion, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san knows her own weapons.
All she has to do is hone them..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...You're confident, aren't you?
...Whereas I...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're covered in mud...
...Ah, late-stage surge training, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is...
Um, in the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Whatever, I don't care.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's with that pathetic look on your face?
...The Shuka Sho is comin' up real soon, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ......I know, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...What's that look for?
Got no confidence?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I possess neither blinding speed, nor a devastating late spurt, nor a strong heart to overcome hardship.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—How is an ordinary person with no weapons to their name
supposed to have confidence, you ask?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...A mediocre person, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then,
is your mother an ordinary person too?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't get mad, it's your own logic.
You're the one who declared you'd prove how amazing your mother is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I am who I am because I'm my mother's daughter...
then the reverse must be true, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Either way is fine by me, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
…………Saying there's nothing...
I'm... such a big liar.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I am—Mother's daughter.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mother's strength has indeed...
been passed down to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...It's not 'nothing.'
I amâ

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: We are... strong...!!

Several days have passed since Daring Heart headed deep into the mountains.
According to the device, her health condition
shows no issues so far.
choice_data_list: (I need to head back to the training camp lodge tomorrow...)

text_block_list.text: Just then—a LANE message popped up on my phone. It was from Daring Heart... looks like she had scheduled it to send.

It was a sea of stars.
A sky packed with brilliant lights stretching as far as the eye could see, the likes of which you could never witness in the city...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—...or something like that,
she's probably muttering right about now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I would've loved to see the look on their face too...
but I'll settle for just imagining it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Because I know you're waiting for me...
I can keep moving forward.)

(Rustle... rustle, rustle...)
(Whoooosh... whooo...)
(........................)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...My senses are sharpening.
Distants sounds, the presence of life...
I feel them all flooding into my heart.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Severance... isolation. A threat to my survival—
It corners me.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Let us head back when the sun rises.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(For now, I will move forward.
At the end of this road... my heart will be complete.)
